hints.title: Track Endings by Vowel
hints.text: At each length step, the count of valid strings ending in each of the five vowels depends on previous ending counts.

hints.title: Apply Transition Rules
hints.text: Vowel a can follow e, i, u; vowel e follows a, i; vowel i follows e, o; vowel o follows i; vowel u follows i, o.

hints.title: Accumulate Modulo 10^9 + 7
hints.text: Perform n - 1 transition rounds starting with 1 for each vowel, and sum the final five counts modulo 1000000007.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def countVowelPermutation(self, n: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        a = e = i = o = u = 1
        for _ in range(n - 1):
            na = (e + i + u) % MOD
            ne = (a + i) % MOD
            ni = (e + o) % MOD
            no = i % MOD
            nu = (i + o) % MOD
            a, e, i, o, u = na, ne, ni, no, nu
        return (a + e + i + o + u) % MOD
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all valid vowel permutations takes exponential 5^N time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating five state transitions per step takes linear time and five scalar variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should translate the transition constraints accurately into simultaneous updates modulo 10^9 + 7.
